articles.title: Trump's China AI U-Turn After Grand Welcome To Xi Stokes Fury, Internet TORCHES 'Super Intelligence'
articles.description: US President Donald Trump’s latest comments on artificial intelligence have put his talks with Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping under the spotlight. Trump said he now prefers calling artificial intelligence “superintelligence” or “SI,” arguing that the term AI makes it sound “fake.” He also claimed the United States is leading China in the technology by at least a year and said he is “not looking to open it up” because America is ahead. The remarks came after Trump and Xi discussed technology and “Super Intelligence” during their high-level talks. While Trump ruled out opening up US-China cooperation on advancing the technology, Washington and Beijing have agreed to establish channels for discussing AI-related incidents and risks, with an AI-specific dialogue planned for November.

articles.title: India’s Drone Power Is Taking Off: From Homegrown KAL to Global Markets
articles.description: India’s drone industry is expanding rapidly, with homegrown companies developing systems for surveillance, logistics and long-range strike missions. At the centre of this growing ecosystem is KAL, a long-range one-way attack drone developed by Noida-based IG Defence.KAL is claimed to have a range of up to 1,000 km, a flight endurance of seven to eight hours and a payload capacity of up to 50 kg. The platform is also drawing reported interest from Gulf countries.But KAL is part of a much bigger story. With hundreds of companies developing drones and components, India is pushing to build an indigenous drone ecosystem and expand its presence in the global defence market.This video looks at KAL, India’s growing drone industry, the country’s military demand for unmanned systems and its ambitions to become a major exporter of drone technology.#India #Drones #KAL #DroneTechnology #MadeInIndia #Defence #DroneWarfare #DefenceTechnology #TOI
